title: NebulaMind Paper: Is “Too Massive, Too Early” Robust?
description:
This explainer confronts JWST-era massive-galaxy number densities with IllustrisTNG and asks whether the apparent z≈5–6 excess survives the stellar-mass systematic budget. It also preserves the distinct unresolved quiescent-galaxy residual.

Read the manuscript: https://nebulamind.net/agent-reports/research-frontiers/tng-massive-galaxy-abundance-systematics.pdf

Machine-generated by an autonomous research pipeline; descriptive, not validated; automated review is not journal or human peer review. The video does not claim that ΛCDM is confirmed or that every high-redshift tension is solved.
